title: byref-return-parenthesized-undefined-var-assignref-rebind-stale-reference-uaf (CWE-416 use-after-free) in Zend/zend_execute.c
live_proof: measured at the pin, not inferred: on a build of php-5.0.0 from the museum tarball (sha256-pinned by the source corpus's src/) the trigger reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free with the detector patches, and OK with Zend's allocator as shipped (results/20261028-host-asan/matrix.tsv, run 2026-10-28). The defective construct is in the pin's own source at Zend/zend_execute.c:2243, quoted in PROVENANCE.md. Upstream fixed it in 8ce349b8e03c, the commit the source corpus records; php-src's history is not available on this host, so the fix hunk is cited by hash and not quoted
fidelity: the trigger is the source corpus's own script for this defect, carried over byte for byte from its corpus/CRASH-067.php; it is upstream-report-derived rather than a reduction of ours, and it drives the defect through the CLI SAPI on the whole interpreter, so it does not isolate the defective construct from the rest of the request. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it

status: host-asan measured 2026-10-28 on this host, both allocator configurations (results/20261028-host-asan); virtual-malloc, virtual-nested-pools and cheribsd-revocation are declared and not yet run
allocator_layer: Zend's allocator, nested inside libc malloc: _efree parks the block in AG(cache) (zend_alloc.c:270-282, payload <= 80 bytes) and free() is never called, so the system allocator never sees the lifetime end
nested_why: the object is a sub-allocation of Zend's allocator: emalloc carves it out of its own malloc'd block (zend_alloc.c:182, header + payload)
layer_note: with Zend's allocator as shipped the host reading is OK, against ASAN:heap-use-after-free with the cache disabled -- which is what places this case in the Zend-allocator corpus
fault_sites_why: host ASan on the pin, our run of 2026-10-28, recorded before any Capstone or CheriBSD run: the report's own access stack is zend_assign_to_variable (Zend/zend_execute.c:676), zend_assign_dim_handler (Zend/zend_execute.c:2221). The interpreter's dispatch frames (execute, zend_do_fcall_common_helper, zend_execute_scripts) are not sites
